summary: Master data visualization with our comprehensive Python training course. Learn to create stunning visuals using Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Plotly. Enroll now!
lede: Data Visualization with Python using Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Plotly helps you turn analysis into clear visual evidence. You will learn to choose appropriate charts, design for clarity, avoid misleading visuals, and create publication-ready results. The course builds a repeatable approach to communicating program outcomes, budget performance, operational KPIs, and research findings. Through practical, hands-on learning, you will develop visuals that support understanding, strengthen recommendations, and help drive action.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who create reports, dashboards, or presentations and need to communicate insights visually using Python.
modules: Visualizing Trends and Performance Over Time
Avoiding Misleading Visuals and Common Mistakes
Reporting Templates and Reusable Code Patterns
Capstone: Build a Visualization Pack for a Real Scenario
prerequisites: Participants are expected to have basic proficiency in Python programming and familiarity with data manipulation libraries such as Pandas. No prior experience with data visualization libraries is required, although beneficial.
